sloka: अहमुत्सादयिष्यामि शत्रूम्स्तव निशाचर ।यदि शक्रविवस्वन्तौ यदि पावकमारुतौ ॥६-१२-३६॥।।
transliteration: ahamutsādayiṣyāmi śatrūmstava niśācara ।yadi śakravivasvantau yadi pāvakamārutau ॥6-12-36॥।।

translations.english: "O Rakshasa I will ruin the enemy. I will fight with both of them (Rama and Lakshmana) even if they are Indra and sun, fire god and wind god or Kubera and Varuna."
